This is the structure of persons/<person_id>/state/quota.json: a view that the agent rebuilds from the journal (DATA_CONTRACT.md sections 3c, 5 and 9.2). If the file is missing or differs from the journal, the journal wins and the file is rebuilt. source_revision is the sequence of the last journal line the counts were taken from (DATA_CONTRACT.md section 1); this is the only name of that field.
